source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 6 (PDF 143-169), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Bioenergetics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
Bioenergetics and ATP: the energy currency of cells

blocks.prompt:
1 The study of how energy flows through living systems is called:
(Zinda nizamon mein energy ke bahao ke mutaale ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bioenergetics woh ilm hai jo batata hai ke zinda nizamon mein energy kaise behti hai, yani cells energy kaise jama aur kharch karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Bioenergetics is the study of how energy flows through living systems

blocks.prompt:
2 Which pair correctly matches the two processes with their roles in bioenergetics?
(Bioenergetics mein dono processes aur un ke kirdar ka sahi jora kaun sa hai?)

options.text: Photosynthesis energy pakarta hai; respiration energy kharij karta hai
Photosynthesis energy kharij karta hai; respiration energy pakarta hai

blocks.explanation: Photosynthesis energy pakarne wala amal hai jab ke respiration energy kharij karne wala amal hai.

book_ref.quote: Photosynthesis acts as an energy–capturing while respiration as an energy-releasing process

blocks.prompt:
3 Nearly all the energy used by living organisms on Earth comes from:
(Zameen par zinda ajsam jo energy istemal karte hain woh taqreeban sari kahan se aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Plants, algae aur kuch bacteria sooraj ki roshni pakar kar use chemical energy mein badalte hain; yeh food chain ki bunyad hai.

book_ref.quote: Nearly all the energy used by living organisms on Earth comes from photosynthesis

blocks.text: ATP: The Energy Currency of Cells

blocks.prompt:
4 Chemically, the energy currency of the cell (ATP) is a:
(Cell ki energy currency (ATP) chemically kya cheez hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell ki energy currency aik nucleotide hai jise adenosine triphosphate (ATP) kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: This currency is actually a nucleotide called adenosine triphosphate (ATP)

blocks.prompt:
5 The sugar present in a molecule of ATP is:
(ATP ke molecule mein kaun si sugar hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: ATP ke teen hisse hain: adenine (nitrogen wali base), ribose (paanch carbon wali sugar) aur teen phosphate groups.

book_ref.quote: ribose (a five-carbon sugar) and three phosphate groups

blocks.prompt:
6 ATP was discovered in 1929 by:
(ATP 1929 mein kis ne daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Karl Lohmann ne 1929 mein ATP daryaft kiya; 1941 mein Fritz Lipmann ne kaha ke ATP cell ka asal energy muntaqil karne wala molecule hai.

book_ref.quote: ATP was discovered in 1929 by Karl Lohmann

blocks.prompt:
7 Who proposed in 1941 that ATP is the main energy-transfer molecule in the cell?
(1941 mein kis ne tajweez di ke ATP cell mein energy muntaqil karne wala asal molecule hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nobel inaam yafta Fritz Lipmann ne 1941 mein yeh tajweez di.

book_ref.quote: Fritz Lipmann proposed that ATP is the main energy-transfer molecule in the cell

blocks.prompt:
8 Breaking one high-energy phosphate bond of ATP releases about:
(ATP ka aik high-energy phosphate bond tootne se taqreeban kitni energy nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik phosphate bond tootne par ATP ke har mole se taqreeban 7.3 kcal (7,300 calories) energy nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: The breaking of one phosphate bond releases about 7.3 kcal (7,300 calories) per mole of ATP

blocks.prompt:
9 In common energy reactions, when only the outer P-P high-energy bond of ATP breaks, ATP becomes:
(Aam energy reactions mein jab ATP ka sirf bahar wala P-P bond toot-ta hai to ATP kya ban jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf bahar wala P-P bond toot-ta hai, is liye ATP, ADP (adenosine diphosphate) ban jata hai aur aik Pi alag hota hai.

book_ref.quote: In common energy reactions only the outer P-P high-energy bond breaks

blocks.prompt:
10 In some cases ADP is further broken down to:
(Kuch soorton mein ADP mazeed toot kar kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: ADP + H₂O → AMP + Pi + energy (7.3 kcal/mole).

book_ref.quote: In some cases, ADP is further broken down to AMP (adenosine monophosphate) and Pi:

blocks.prompt:
11 ATP is made during ____ processes and broken down during ____ processes.
(ATP ____ processes mein banta hai aur ____ processes mein toot-ta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Cells khurak ki oxidation se mili energy ADP aur Pi jor kar ATP mein rakhte hain; energy kharch karne wale kaamon mein ATP toot-ta hai.

book_ref.quote: ATP is made during energy-releasing processes and it is broken down during energy-consuming processes

blocks.prompt:
12 Why does water appear on both sides of the summary equation of photosynthesis?
(Photosynthesis ki khulasa equation mein pani dono taraf kyun aata hai?)

options.text: Yeh sirf solvent hai, hissa nahi leta
Yeh sirf respiration se banta hai
Yeh photosynthesis ka asal product hai
Kuch reactions mein reactant hai aur kuch mein product ke taur par nikalta hai

blocks.explanation: Pani kuch reactions mein istemal hota hai aur kuch mein bantaa hai; pani ka koi net hasil nahi.

book_ref.quote: Water appears on both sides of the equation because water is used as reactant in some reactions

blocks.prompt:
13 In the summary equation of photosynthesis, the products are:
(Photosynthesis ki khulasa equation mein products kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: CO₂, pani aur roshni reactants hain; glucose aur oxygen products hain.

book_ref.quote: Carbon dioxide, water and light are the reactants while glucose and oxygen are the products

blocks.prompt:
14 The moment when there is no net gas exchange between leaves and atmosphere because photosynthesis and respiration are equal is called:
(Woh lamha jab photosynthesis aur respiration barabar hon aur pattiyon aur hawa ke darmiyan gas ka koi net tabadla na ho, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Subah aur shaam kam roshni mein dono rates thori der barabar ho sakte hain; isay compensation point kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: This is termed as compensation point

blocks.prompt:
15 The compensation point is usually reached:
(Compensation point aam tor par kab aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Subah aur shaam roshni kam hoti hai is liye photosynthesis aur respiration thori der barabar ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: At dawn and dusk, when light intensity is low, the rate of photosynthesis and respiration may be equal

blocks.prompt:
16 At noon, when light intensity is high, the leaves show:
(Dopehar ko jab roshni tez hoti hai to pattiyan kya karti hain?)

options.text: carbon dioxide ka net ikhraj aur oxygen ka jazb
oxygen ka net ikhraj aur carbon dioxide ka jazb

blocks.explanation: Dopehar ko photosynthesis tez hota hai; respiration kaafi CO₂ nahi de sakta aur oxygen zaroorat se zyada banti hai.

book_ref.quote: So, the result is the net release of oxygen coupled with the uptake of carbon dioxide

blocks.prompt:
17 During photosynthesis, the hydrogen used for the reduction of CO₂ comes from:
(Photosynthesis mein CO₂ ki reduction ke liye hydrogen kahan se aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO₂ ki reduction ke liye hydrogen pani se aati hai.

book_ref.quote: Water is the source of hydrogen, for the reduction of CO₂ during photosynthesis

blocks.prompt:
18 In the 1930s, who hypothesized that plants split water as a source of hydrogen, releasing oxygen as a by-product?
(1930s mein kis ne mafrooza diya ke plants hydrogen ke liye pani ko torte hain aur oxygen zimni product hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh mafrooza C. B. van Niel ne diya (kitab mein 'Van Neil' chhapa hai); 1940s mein is ki tasdeeq hui.

book_ref.quote: In 1930s, Van Neil hypothesized that plant splits water as a source of hydrogen

blocks.prompt:
19 Which isotopic tracer was used to confirm that the oxygen of photosynthesis comes from water?
(Yeh sabit karne ke liye ke photosynthesis ki oxygen pani se aati hai, kaun sa isotopic tracer istemal hua?)
blocks.explanation: Scientists ne heavy oxygen (¹⁸O) se H₂¹⁸O aur C¹⁸O₂ tayyar kiye.

book_ref.quote: An experiment was conducted in which isotopic tracer (¹⁸O) of oxygen was used

blocks.prompt:
20 Plants given H₂¹⁸O and normal CO₂ released:
(Jin plants ko H₂¹⁸O aur aam CO₂ diya gaya unhon ne kaun si oxygen kharij ki?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle group (H₂¹⁸O + C¹⁶O₂) ne ¹⁸O banai, yani nikalne wali oxygen pani se aati hai.

book_ref.quote: It was found that plants of first group produced ¹⁸O but the plants of second group produced normal oxygen

blocks.prompt:
21 The 'reducing power' for the reduction of CO₂ to sugar is:
(CO₂ ko sugar mein badalne ke liye 'reducing power' kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pani ki hydrogen NADP ko NADPH banati hai, jo CO₂ ki reduction ki reducing power hai.

book_ref.quote: This hydrogen reduces the coenzyme nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADP) to NADPH

blocks.prompt:
22 Photosynthetic pigments are present in:
(Photosynthetic pigments kahan hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Photosynthetic pigments thylakoid membranes mein hote hain aur roshni ki energy pakarte hain.

book_ref.quote: Photosynthetic pigments are present in thylakoid membranes

blocks.prompt:
23 Light behaves like a stream of particles called:
(Roshni zarraat ki aik lehar ki tarah behave karti hai jinhein kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Roshni photons ki lehar ki tarah hai; pigment molecule aik waqt mein aik photon jazb karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Light behaves like a stream of particles called photons

blocks.prompt:
24 Compared with red photons, blue photons have:
(Surkh photons ke muqable mein neelay photons mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhoti wavelength wale (neelay) photons mein lambi wavelength wale (surkh) photons se zyada energy hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Short wavelength photons (blue) have a higher energy than long wavelength (red) photons

blocks.prompt:
25 Chlorophylls found in photosynthetic bacteria are known as:
(Photosynthetic bacteria mein paye jane wale chlorophylls ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorophyll a, b, c aur d plants aur algae mein hain; bacteria wale chlorophylls bacteriochlorophylls kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: while the others are found in photosynthetic bacteria and are known as bacteriochlorophylls

blocks.prompt:
26 The four pyrrole rings of the porphyrin ring of chlorophyll are held together by a central atom of:
(Chlorophyll ke porphyrin ring ke chaar pyrrole rings ko darmiyan mein kaun sa atom jorta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar pyrrole rings ko darmiyan mein magnesium ka atom jorta hai.

book_ref.quote: The four pyrrole rings are held together by a magnesium atom in the centre

blocks.prompt:
27 Which part of the chlorophyll molecule anchors it in the thylakoid membrane?
(Chlorophyll molecule ka kaun sa hissa use thylakoid membrane mein jamaye rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrophobic tail lambi hydrocarbon chain hai jo molecule ko membrane mein jamati hai; porphyrin head roshni jazb karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The tail is made of long hydrocarbon chain. It anchors the molecule in the thylakoid membrane

blocks.prompt:
28 Which wavelengths are least absorbed by chlorophylls?
(Chlorophylls kaun si wavelengths sab se kam jazb karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorophylls zyada tar violet-blue aur orange-red jazb karte hain; green sab se kam jazb hoti hai aur guzar jati ya palat jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Green wavelengths are least absorbed by chlorophylls and are transmitted or reflected

blocks.prompt:
29 Besides capturing light, carotenoids such as beta-carotene also:
(Roshni pakarne ke ilawa carotenoids (jaise beta-carotene) aur kya karte hain?)

options.text: pani tor kar oxygen nikalte hain
photosynthetic nizam ko zyada roshni ke nuqsan se bachate hain
CO₂ ko sugar mein fix karte hain

blocks.explanation: Carotenoids blue aur green hisse ki roshni pakarte hain aur zyada roshni se photosynthetic nizam ko nuqsan se bachate hain.

book_ref.quote: Carotenoids, such as beta-carotene, play dual role in photosynthesis

blocks.prompt:
30 Phycobilins are accessory pigments found in:
(Phycobilins (accessory pigments) kin mein paye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorophyll b aur carotenoids plants mein hain jab ke phycobilins red algae aur cyanobacteria mein hain.

book_ref.quote: phycobilins are found in the red algae and cyanobacteria

blocks.prompt:
31 Which of these is NOT an accessory pigment?
(Inn mein se kaun sa accessory pigment NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorophyll a ke ilawa woh sab pigments jo photosynthesis ke liye roshni jama karte hain accessory pigments hain.

book_ref.quote: Accessory pigments include all the pigments, other than chlorophyll-a

blocks.prompt:
32 The generally believed order of energy transfer among pigments in plants is:
(Plants mein pigments ke darmiyan energy muntaqil hone ki aam tarteeb kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Accessory pigments energy chlorophyll a ki taraf dete hain: carotenoids → chlorophyll b → chlorophyll a.

book_ref.quote: It is generally believed that the order of transfer of energy in plants is;

blocks.prompt:
33 The absorption spectrum of chlorophylls shows maximum absorption at about:
(Chlorophylls ka absorption spectrum kis wavelength par sab se zyada absorption dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se zyada absorption blue (430 nm) aur red (670 nm) roshni ka hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Absorption spectrum of chlorophylls indicates that absorption of blue light (430 nm) and red light (670 nm) is maximum

blocks.prompt:
34 Some wavelengths not absorbed by chlorophyll a are absorbed well by chlorophyll b and vice versa. This:
(Kuch wavelengths jo chlorophyll a jazb nahi karta, chlorophyll b achhi tarah jazb karta hai aur ulta bhi. Is ka nateeja?)

options.text: jazb hone wali roshni ki range barhata hai
chlorophyll b ko reaction centre pigment bana deta hai

blocks.explanation: Aisa farq dono chlorophylls ki jazb ki hui roshni ki range barha deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Such differences increase the range of light absorbed by both chlorophylls

blocks.prompt:
35 About what percentage of the solar energy received do plants convert into chemical energy?
(Plants mili hui solar energy ka taqreeban kitna hissa chemical energy mein badalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Plants sirf taqreeban 1-2% solar energy chemical energy mein badalte hain; phir bhi yeh taqreeban sari zindagi ke liye kaafi hai.

book_ref.quote: Plants convert only about 1-2% of the solar energy they receive into chemical energy

blocks.prompt:
36 The light energy converted into chemical energy is stored in organic compounds in the form of:
(Roshni se bani chemical energy organic compounds mein kis shakal mein jama hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jazb shuda roshni ki energy chemical energy ban kar C-H bond energy ki shakal mein jama hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: stored in organic compounds in the form of C-H bond energy

blocks.prompt:
37 The first action spectrum was made in 1883 by:
(Pehla action spectrum 1883 mein kis ne banaya?)
blocks.explanation: German biologist T. W. Engelmann ne 1883 mein pehla action spectrum banaya.

book_ref.quote: The first action spectrum was made by a German biologist, T. W. Engelmann in 1883

blocks.prompt:
38 Engelmann made the first action spectrum using the alga:
(Engelmann ne pehla action spectrum kis alga par banaya?)
blocks.explanation: Unhon ne Spirogyra ke photosynthetic pigments par kaam kiya.

book_ref.quote: He worked on the photosynthetic pigments of Spirogyra

blocks.prompt:
39 While making an action spectrum, the rate of photosynthesis is measured by the amount of:
(Action spectrum banate waqt photosynthesis ki rate kis cheez ki miqdaar se naapi jati hai?)

options.text: jaron ka jazb kiya hua pani

blocks.explanation: Plant ko aik aik kar ke mukhtalif rangon ki roshni di jati hai aur har rang par pattiyon se nikalne wali oxygen naapi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: the rate of photosynthesis is measured by measuring the amount of oxygen emitted from leaves

blocks.prompt:
40 In Engelmann's experiment, maximum oxygen was emitted from the Spirogyra cells receiving:
(Engelmann ke tajurbe mein Spirogyra ke kin cells se sab se zyada oxygen nikli?)
blocks.explanation: Blue aur red roshni pane wale cells mein sab se zyada photosynthesis hua aur sab se zyada oxygen nikli.

book_ref.quote: maximum photosynthesis occurred in the cells which received blue and red spectrum of light

blocks.prompt:
41 In photosynthesis, CO₂ acts as the source of:
(Photosynthesis mein CO₂ kis cheez ka zariya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sugar CO₂ ki ATP aur NADPH se reduction se banti hai; CO₂ carbon ka zariya hai.

book_ref.quote: In this way, CO₂ acts as the source of carbon for making sugars

blocks.prompt:
42 The entry of CO₂ into the leaves depends upon:
(Pattiyon mein CO₂ ka dakhla kis par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO₂ stomata se andar aa kar mesophyll cell walls ke pani mein hal hoti hai; yeh stomata ke khulne par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: The entry of CO₂ into the leaves is dependent upon the opening of stomata

blocks.prompt:
43 Aquatic photosynthetic organisms use as their carbon source:
(Pani mein rehne wale photosynthetic ajsam carbon ke liye kya istemal karte hain?)

options.text: dissolved CO₂, bicarbonates and soluble carbonates

blocks.explanation: Aabi ajsam hal shuda CO₂, bicarbonates aur soluble carbonates istemal karte hain; khushki wale hawa ki CO₂.

book_ref.quote: Aquatic photosynthetic organisms use dissolved CO₂, bicarbonates and soluble carbonates as carbon source

blocks.prompt:
44 Clusters of photosynthetic pigments embedded in thylakoid membranes are called:
(Thylakoid membranes mein lage photosynthetic pigments ke guchhon ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Solar energy ke behtar istemal ke liye pigments guchhon mein hote hain jinhein photosystems kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: photosynthetic pigments are organized into clusters, called photosystems

blocks.prompt:
45 Each photosystem consists of:
(Har photosystem kin do hisson par mushtamil hai?)

options.text: an antenna complex and a reaction centre

blocks.explanation: Har photosystem mein roshni jama karne wala antenna complex aur aik reaction centre hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Each photosystem consists of a light gathering ‘antenna complex’ and a ‘reaction centre’

blocks.prompt:
46 The reaction centre of a photosystem has one or more molecules of:
(Photosystem ke reaction centre mein kis ke aik ya zyada molecules hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction centre mein chlorophyll a hota hai jo high-energy electrons primary electron acceptor ko deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The reaction centre has one or more molecules of chlorophyll-a

blocks.prompt:
47 Photosystem-I and photosystem-II are named so in order of their:
(Photosystem-I aur photosystem-II ke naam kis tarteeb se rakhe gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono photosystems ke naam un ki daryaft ki tarteeb se hain.

book_ref.quote: These are named so in order of their discovery

blocks.prompt:
48 The reaction centre of PS-I has:
(PS-I ke reaction centre mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: PS-I mein P700 chlorophyll a hai jo 700 nm ki roshni sab se zyada jazb karta hai; PS-II mein P680 (680 nm).

book_ref.quote: PS-I has P700 chlorophyll-a molecule in its reaction centre

blocks.prompt:
49 The light-dependent reactions take place:
(Light-dependent reactions kahan hoti hain?)

options.text: on the thylakoid membranes of the grana

blocks.explanation: Light-dependent reactions grana ki thylakoid membranes par aur light-independent reactions stroma mein hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: The light-dependent reactions take place on the thylakoid membranes of the grana

blocks.prompt:
50 The formation of ATP in the light-dependent reactions is called:
(Light-dependent reactions mein ATP banne ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Light-dependent reactions ka sab se aham qadam, ATP ka banna, photophosphorylation kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: The formation of ATP is the most important step of light-dependent reactions

blocks.prompt:
51 In non-cyclic photophosphorylation:
(Non-cyclic photophosphorylation mein:)

options.text: PS-I aur PS-II dono hissa lete hain

blocks.explanation: Non-cyclic raste mein dono photosystems hissa lete hain aur do electron chains shamil hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: In non-cyclic pathway, both photosystems i.e., PS-I and PS-II participate

blocks.prompt:
52 After losing its excited electrons, P680 chlorophyll becomes:
(Apne excited electrons kho dene ke baad P680 chlorophyll kya ban jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: P680 mein electron 'hole' ban jata hai aur woh taqatwar oxidizing agent ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: an electron “hole” is created in p680 chlorophyll, which has become a strong oxidizing agent

blocks.prompt:
53 The water-splitting step of photosynthesis is called:
(Photosynthesis mein pani torne wale qadam ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: PS-II ke oxidized chlorophyll se mil kar pani 2H⁺, aik oxygen atom aur do electrons mein toot-ta hai: photolysis.

book_ref.quote: This water splitting step of photosynthesis is called photolysis

blocks.prompt:
54 The main source of atmospheric oxygen is the oxygen produced during:
(Fazai oxygen ka asal zariya kis amal mein bani oxygen hai?)
blocks.explanation: Photolysis mein bani oxygen fazai oxygen ka asal zariya hai.

book_ref.quote: The oxygen produced during photolysis is the main source of atmospheric oxygen

blocks.prompt:
55 The electron transport chain between PS-II and PS-I consists of:
(PS-II aur PS-I ke darmiyan electron transport chain kin carriers par mushtamil hai?)

options.text: coenzyme Q, cytochrome b and cytochrome c

blocks.explanation: PS-II ki chain mein plastoquinone (PQ), cytochrome complex aur plastocyanin (PC) hain.

book_ref.quote: This chain consists of electron carriers called plastoquinone (PQ), cytochrome complex, and plastocyanin (PC)

blocks.prompt:
56 In the second electron transport chain, the photoexcited electrons from PS-I are first received by:
(Doosri electron transport chain mein PS-I ke excited electrons sab se pehle kaun leta hai?)
blocks.explanation: PS-I ka primary acceptor electrons doosri chain ko deta hai jahan ferredoxin (FD) unhein leta hai.

book_ref.quote: These electrons are received by ferredoxin (FD)

blocks.prompt:
57 The enzyme that transfers electrons from ferredoxin to NADP⁺ is:
(Ferredoxin se electrons NADP⁺ ko kaun sa enzyme deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: NADP reductase electrons FD se NADP⁺ ko deta hai; do electrons aur aik H⁺ se NADP⁺ NADPH ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: An enzyme NADP reductase transfers these electrons from FD to NADP⁺

blocks.prompt:
58 The zigzag path of electrons through PS-II, PS-I and the electron transport chains is called:
(PS-II, PS-I aur electron transport chains mein electrons ke zigzag raste ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh zigzag rasta Z-scheme hai jo PS-II aur PS-I se guzarta hai (kitab mein 'PS-II and PS-II' ghalat chhapa hai).

book_ref.quote: The zigzag path taken by electrons through PS-II and PS-II and electron transport chains, is called Z-scheme

blocks.prompt:
59 Cyclic electron flow uses:
(Cyclic electron flow kis ko istemal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyclic electron flow sirf PS-I istemal karta hai, PS-II nahi; electrons wapas P700 par aate hain.

book_ref.quote: This path uses PS-I but not PS-II

blocks.prompt:
60 Cyclic photophosphorylation happens when:
(Cyclic photophosphorylation kab hoti hai?)

options.text: Calvin cycle sust ho aur NADPH jama ho jaye

blocks.explanation: Jab Calvin cycle sust ho aur chloroplast mein NADPH jama ho jaye; is se ATP banta hai, NADPH ya O₂ nahi.

book_ref.quote: It happens when Calvin cycle slows down and NADPH accumulates in chloroplast

blocks.prompt:
61 In the chloroplast, the energy released from electrons is used to pump H⁺ ions:
(Chloroplast mein electrons se nikli energy H⁺ ions ko kahan se kahan pump karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh energy H⁺ ions ko stroma se andar wale hisse (lumen) mein active transport ke liye kharch hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: this energy is spent for the active transport of H⁺ ions from the stroma of chloroplast to its inner compartment (lumen)

blocks.prompt:
62 The membrane protein through which H⁺ ions diffuse back and which joins ADP with Pi is:
(Woh membrane protein jis se H⁺ ions wapas guzarte hain aur jo ADP ko Pi se jorta hai:)
blocks.explanation: ATP synthase H⁺ ke bahao ki energy se ADP ko inorganic phosphate se jorta hai.

book_ref.quote: This protein is an enzyme called ATP synthase

blocks.prompt:
63 ATP is generated by chemiosmosis in:
(Chemiosmosis se ATP kahan banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mitochondria aur chloroplasts dono ki electron transport chains chemiosmosis se ATP banati hain.

book_ref.quote: The electron transport chains in mitochondria and chloroplasts generate ATP by the same mechanism of chemiosmosis

blocks.prompt:
64 The light-independent reactions happen in the:
(Light-independent reactions kahan hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh stroma mein hoti hain; CO₂ se carbon, ATP se energy aur NADPH se hydrogen leti hain.

book_ref.quote: Light-independent reactions are a series of reactions which happen in the stroma of chloroplast

blocks.prompt:
65 The 'dark reactions' of photosynthesis can occur:
(Photosynthesis ki 'dark reactions' kab ho sakti hain?)

options.text: roshni ya andhere mein, jab tak ATP aur NADPH maujood hon

blocks.explanation: Jab tak ATP aur NADPH maujood hon yeh roshni ho ya na ho, dono halaat mein ho sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: These reactions can occur in the absence as well as in the presence of light

blocks.prompt:
66 Melvin Calvin was awarded the Nobel Prize for working out the dark reactions in:
(Melvin Calvin ko dark reactions daryaft karne par Nobel Prize kab mila?)
blocks.explanation: Calvin aur saathiyon ne University of California mein yeh tafseel daryaft ki; 1961 mein Nobel Prize mila.

book_ref.quote: Calvin was awarded Nobel Prize in 1961 for this work

blocks.prompt:
67 The enzyme that is probably the most abundant protein on Earth is:
(Woh enzyme jo shayad zameen par sab se zyada paya jane wala protein hai:)
blocks.explanation: Ribulose biphosphate carboxylase (rubisco) shayad zameen par sab se zyada paya jane wala protein hai.

book_ref.quote: probably the most abundant protein on Earth

blocks.prompt:
68 The initial incorporation of CO₂ into organic material is called:
(CO₂ ka organic maadde mein pehli baar shamil hona kya kehlata hai?)
